name: detail-D-opening_perimeter-SAUNA_LINER_INT-826e97

nodes.content: CASING 3/4" x 2 1/2" cedar-sauna-trim, 3/16" REVEAL TO JAMB

notes: • Sauna liner: 2" foil-faced polyiso, taped seams, over the wall and the ceiling.
• Liner furring: 1/2" plywood strips. Fasten to framing per IRC Table R703.15.2.
• Liner finish: 5/4 shiplap, 5-1/2" face over 5". Basswood, poplar or aspen.
• Wall liner is banded to 90 inches AFF above the finished ceiling at 84 1/16 inches; keep the ceiling/wall vapor-control junction continuous.
• Sauna floor: 4" slab on R-10 XPS at 25 psi on 10 mil polyethylene.
• Slab perimeter isolation joint: 1" XPS with 1/2" polyurethane sealant.
• Base: 6" fiber cement replaces shiplap and furring, membrane lapped up it.
• Foundation: 8" wall, #6 at 48" o.c., on a 25"x15" footing over washed stone.
• Independent lying bench at 42 inches, foot platform at 24 inches and lighting rails at 16 inches AFF.
• Drop framing: 2x4 wall on the pour, 2x4 ceiling hung from the I-joists.
• Footing drain: perforated pipe in the stone beside the footing, not under.
K1  Furring to the pour: masonry anchors, embedment verified for the substrate.
K3  Return the foil facing into the jamb and seal it. Do not stop it short.
